claim.value: Evaluation of canary phase and tail changes should include whether failures increase.
claim.scope: The proposed favorable outcome requires no increase in failures; no actual failure rate is reported.

provenance.rationale: P022 explicitly includes the absence of increased failures in the proposed canary outcome.

signal_basis.value: Evaluate whether the canary changes the predicted phase and overall tail without increasing failures or unfinished exports.
signal_basis.scope: A proposed canary comparison; the mapping reports no measured outcome.

provenance.rationale: P022 supplies the phase, tail, failure and completion dimensions of the proposed evaluation.
The claim is supported without an additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: The specified favorable signal includes no increase in failures, so evaluating whether that signal occurs requires checking failures alongside phase and tail changes. This licenses the narrow evaluation requirement.
uncertainty: Actual canary performance is unreported, but that does not undermine the stated evaluation requirement.
